InterActAIve

Your content. Your brand. Now interactive.

1What would you like to call your AI agent?

InterActAIve

2The problem

Teams spend a lot of time turning good content into good-looking presentations. Corporate PowerPoint templates keep branding consistent, but the final output is still mostly static. Creating richer HTML-based presentations today usually needs design or development skills, which makes it difficult for everyday teams to use.

3The solution

InterActAIve lets a colleague choose an approved Aviva presentation style, add their content and have an AI agent turn it into a branded interactive HTML presentation. Instead of freely designing, the agent assembles approved components such as KPI cards, timelines, diagrams, expandable sections and interactive charts. The user gets a ready-to-review HTML experience without needing to write code.

Other: Create branded interactive HTML presentations from approved templates and user content.
